channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Drones Hit Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan Region
item.description: Drones launched from neighboring Iran have struck Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan autonomous region, injuring two people, according to Azerbaijan's Foreign Affairs Ministry.

item.title: More Videos Show Apparent Drone Attack On Nakhchivan Airport, School Area
item.description: Drones launched from neighboring Iran have struck Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan autonomous region, injuring two people, according to Azerbaijan's Foreign Affairs Ministry. Another drone strike near a school was also reported in social media posts.

item.title: Michael Knights: Gulf Region On The Precipice Of Fundamental Change
item.description: Michael Knights, head of research at Horizon Engage, a New York–based strategic advisory firm and an adjunct fellow at The Washington Institute, spoke with RFE/RL about what the likely objectives are in the US-Israel campaign against Iran and what may happen if they aren't achieved.

item.title: Waiting Out The War: Stories Of Kyrgyz Citizens In Tehran
item.description: Like many Central Asian citizens in Iran, Kyrgyz nationals are facing life under US-Israeli strikes. Two citizens spoke to RFE/RL’s Kyrgyz Service of their experiences: some remain in Tehran, watching explosions from their homes, while others have been evacuated to Baku after long, tense journeys.

item.title: 'A Dangerous Situation': Azerbaijan Fears Becoming Embroiled In Widening Iran War
item.description: In Iran’s northwestern neighbor, Azerbaijan, there are fears that the country could become embroiled in the US-Israeli war against the Islamic republic. On March 5, drones hit Azerbaijan’s Nakhchivan region near the Iranian border.

item.title: Ukraine, Russia Conduct 200-For-200 POW Exchange
item.description: Ukraine and Russia carried out their second prisoner-of-war exchange of 2026, with 200 captured soldiers returned by each side. The exchange is described as the first stage of a broader process agreed during talks in Geneva.

item.title: Iranians Flee To Armenia As Air Strikes Continue
item.description: Iranians crossing the border into Armenia as they flee US and Israeli air strikes had mixed feelings when they spoke to RFE/RL, painting a picture of the frightening situation they left behind while also expressing relief over the toppling of senior leadership.

item.title: Israel Strikes Lebanon As Lawmaker Says Goal Is To 'Topple Regime' In Iran
item.description: Israel hit targets in Iran and southern Lebanon on the sixth day of the joint US-Israeli campaign. Reporting from Tel Aviv, RFE/RL correspondent Ray Furlong spoke to an opposition politician who said Israel's goal for a "final result" of the war is to bring down the regime in Tehran.

item.title: Trump Calls On Iran Forces To Lay Down Arms, Civilians To Revolt
item.description: US President Donald Trump called on members of Iran’s military, police, and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to lay down their arms, promising “total immunity” if they abandon the country’s ruling clerical establishment.

item.title: Dana Stroul: US, Israel Achieving Military Gains In Iran, But Political End Remains Unclear
item.description: US and Israeli air strikes are delivering military blows against Iran, but Washington still lacks a defined political strategy for what comes after the fighting, Dana Stroul, former deputy assistant secretary of defense for the Middle East said in an interview with Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.
